**Built slice B of #889: brain:audit prints [LANE] for a records-only lane merge with the PR-body marker; local-checks warns on index lag without mutating**

**What**: Added the [LANE] row to brain-audit.mjs's first-parent walk (classified by classifyLane's lanePaths over the diff against the first parent AND the /^Memory lane: /m marker read from issueLinkBody, before evaluateMerge, so a squashed lane merge is not a false issueLink failure; the [UNCOMPUTABLE] guard keeps an unreachable PR from fabricating a lane), brain/scripts/memory/index-lag.mjs (rebuilds the index in memory with readRecords' first-wins rule, compares id sets with the committed index.jsonl, prints a WARNING with counts including missing and stale, never fails, never writes; a local-checks step in governance.yml and the GitLab mirror; registered in VERIFICATION_SURFACE.scripts), and the carried lane-scrub correction (a bad secret regex and an unreadable record are two distinct uncomputable reasons, both exit 2). Epic task 3.1c ticked.

**Why**: Wave 3 slice 3.1c of #864 (PR 2 of #889; slice A shipped as #905/#907 with size:exception). ADR-0034 L3 and D4.

**Where**: brain/scripts/brain-audit.mjs, brain/scripts/memory/index-lag.mjs, brain/scripts/vcs/governance-tiers.mjs, .github/workflows/governance.yml, brain/scripts/ci/gitlab-governance.yml, brain/scripts/governance/lane-scrub.mjs; openspec/changes/issue-889-lane-governance/**.

**Learned**: GitHub squash merges carry the branch commit messages, never the PR description, and the lane commit has a subject with no body, so [LANE] depends entirely on gh pr view returning the PR body: an unauthenticated brain:audit over a window with a lane merge prints [UNCOMPUTABLE] and exits 2 by design. A fresh review found the only happy-path test riding the commit-body fallback; the production-shape test now kills the mutant. A [LANE] row skips all of evaluateMerge.
